label: New Player Stats view — the advanced-stats leaderboard (from the desktop Stats Workbench) is now on mobile: position tabs (QB/RB/WR/TE/DL/LB/DB/PK/PN) with curated per-position columns, search, and tap a player for the full sheet. Reach it from the Home 'Player Stats' tile or the League → Stats tab. Positional rank now buckets by IDP group (DL/LB/DB) so each group has one #1, and positions read in MFL's vocabulary (LB for all linebackers).
